description: This Java class 'RequestReceiver' implements a server socket that listens for incoming requests, deserializes JSON requests using Jackson, and executes associated request logic in a separate thread.

classes.name: RequestReceiver
classes.description: Main class that manages a server socket to receive and process requests asynchronously.

classes.name: RequestReceiver.ReceiverThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread that handles incoming socket connections, deserializes requests, and executes them.

methods.name: RequestReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with a specific port number.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server socket and the receiver thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the receiver thread and closes the server socket.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution loop of the ReceiverThread, accepting connections, deserializing requests, and executing them.
